samples.question: The top card is the REFERENCE. Each card has one dot of each color. To find layers, imagine a tight convex rubber band around the centers of all remaining dots: every dot touched by the band is the next layer. Remove that layer and repeat until no dots remain. Which colored border encloses the option with exactly the same dot colors in every layer as the reference? Answer red, blue, or gold.
